set -euo pipefail
TR='/var/folders/cm/zpwxmr512rq1qz4_0_ryz8t80000gn/T/ubp-pi-entry3-k556s70z/trial/D3-workspace'
QA=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ubp-pi-candidate3-d3-qa.XXXXXX)
cp -a "$TR/meeting-notes" "$QA/meeting-notes"
cp -a "$TR/money-split" "$QA/money-split"
DB="$QA/meeting-notes/qa-notes.db"
{
 echo '$ notes add'; python3 "$QA/meeting-notes/mnotes.py" --db "$DB" add -d 2026-09-01 -t '预算决定' -m '决定：保留预算，供应商确认'; python3 "$QA/meeting-notes/mnotes.py" --db "$DB" add -d 2026-09-05 -t '预算复盘' -m '决定：预算复盘下周完成'
 echo '$ notes find in fresh process'; python3 "$QA/meeting-notes/mnotes.py" --db "$DB" find 决定
 echo '$ notes list in fresh process'; python3 "$QA/meeting-notes/mnotes.py" --db "$DB" list -n 20
 echo '$ notes persistence in another fresh process'; python3 - <<PY
import sqlite3
rows=sqlite3.connect('$DB').execute('select id,occurred_on,title from notes order by occurred_on desc,id desc').fetchall()
print(rows)
assert rows == [(2,'2026-09-05','预算复盘'),(1,'2026-09-01','预算决定')]
PY
 echo '$ money split zero and 1000/3'; node - <<'JS'
const {splitAmount, formatAmount, summarizeSplit} = require(process.env.MONEY_JS);
try { splitAmount(1000, 0); } catch (e) { console.log('zero_error', e.name, e.message); if (!(e instanceof RangeError) || !e.message.includes('大于 0')) process.exit(1); }
const shares = splitAmount(1000, 3); console.log('shares', shares, 'sum', shares.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0), 'formatted', shares.map(formatAmount), 'summary', summarizeSplit(1000,3));
if (JSON.stringify(shares)!=='[334,333,333]' || shares.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)!==1000) process.exit(1);
JS
} > /tmp/d3ops.log
cat /tmp/d3ops.log
printf 'QA=%s\n' "$QA"
